template.name: initializer
template.declaration: void place_all() { place_car(1, 2, 3, 2, true); // red place_car(2, 2, 0, 0, true); // green place_car(3, 2, 2, 0, true); // orange place_car(4, 2, 4, 0, false); // blue place_car(5, 2, 2, 1, false); // pink place_car(6, 3, 5, 1, false); // yellow place_car(7, 2, 1, 2, false); // purple place_car(8, 3, 0, 3, false); // magenta place_car(9, 2, 3, 3, true); // darkgreen place_car(10, 2, 3, 4, false); // gray place_car(11, 2, 4, 4, true); // beige place_car(12, 2, 1, 5, true); // brown place_car(13, 2, 4, 5, true); // black }

template.name: verticalCar
template.parameter: int id, int length, int x, int y

transition.label: canMove(id, x, y, 0, -1, length, false)
move_car(id, x, y, 0, -1, length, false), y--
canMove(id, x, y, 0, 1, length, false)
move_car(id, x, y, 0, 1, length, false), y++

template.name: horizontalCar
template.parameter: int id, int length, int x, int y

transition.label: canMove(id, x, y, -1, 0, length, true)
move_car(id, x, y, -1, 0, length, true), x--
canMove(id, x, y, 1, 0, length, true)
move_car(id, x, y, 1, 0, length, true), x++
